Lash tip 💡 Never pull your clusters off!

1. Soak a cotton pad in oil-based remover
2. Hold it on your lashes for 1–2 minutes
3. Slide the clusters off gently from the base
4. Wash and let your natural lashes breathe 💕

posts.t: Lash tip: map before you stick
posts.pic: Fri 13 Nov picture, in your media library (Sales pictures → Nov 11–30 posts)
posts.text:
Cluster lash tip 💡 MAP before you stick!

Most "my clusters look off" problems start here:
1. Split the lash line into inner, middle and outer
2. Shortest lengths inner, longest outer (for a cat-eye look)
3. Lay the clusters out on your hand in order BEFORE you glue
4. Work outer corner in, so you can see the shape building

Our students practise this on mapping sheets before they ever touch a client 💗
Save this for your next set 📌

#ClusterLashes #LashTips #BajanBeauty

posts.t: Price it right: pay yourself too
posts.pic: Fri 20 Nov picture, in your media library (Sales pictures → Nov 11–30 posts)
posts.text:
Small business tip 💡 Are you paying YOURSELF?

When you price a product, add up:
✔️ What it cost to make or buy
✔️ Packaging and delivery
✔️ Your TIME (yes, it counts!)
✔️ Fees (card, platform, transport)
✔️ Then add your profit on top

If you only cover your costs, you're running a very busy hobby 😅

Save this for your next price check 📌

#SmallBusinessTips #BajanBusiness #PricingTips

posts.t: Aftercare tips that bring clients back
posts.pic: Wed 25 Nov picture, in your media library (Sales pictures → Nov 11–30 posts)
posts.text:
Want clients to come BACK? Give them aftercare 💗

Tell every cluster lash client:
1. Keep them dry for the first 24 hours
2. No oil-based cleansers near the lashes
3. Brush them gently every morning
4. Never pull them off: use remover and let them slide

Clients who look after their lashes love their results, and come back to you 🔁

Save this, lash girls 📌

#LashAftercare #ClusterLashes #LashTech

calendar.t: Lash tip: map before you stick
calendar.text:
Cluster lash tip 💡 MAP before you stick!

Most "my clusters look off" problems start here:
1. Split the lash line into inner, middle and outer
2. Shortest lengths inner, longest outer (for a cat-eye look)
3. Lay the clusters out on your hand in order BEFORE you glue
4. Work outer corner in, so you can see the shape building

Our students practise this on mapping sheets before they ever touch a client 💗
Save this for your next set 📌

#ClusterLashes #LashTips #BajanBeauty

5 phone photo tips that make your products SELL 📸

1. Shoot near a window in daylight, no flash
2. Use a plain background: a white sheet or poster board works
3. Wipe your camera lens first (seriously!)
4. Take one photo close up and one showing size, in a hand or next to something
5. Same background for every product so your shop looks neat

Save this and try it this weekend 📌
Then put those photos in your own shop: thegirlsclub246.com/brands

#SmallBusinessTips #ProductPhotography #BajanBusiness

calendar.t: Price it right: pay yourself too
calendar.text:
Small business tip 💡 Are you paying YOURSELF?

When you price a product, add up:
✔️ What it cost to make or buy
✔️ Packaging and delivery
✔️ Your TIME (yes, it counts!)
✔️ Fees (card, platform, transport)
✔️ Then add your profit on top

If you only cover your costs, you're running a very busy hobby 😅

Save this for your next price check 📌

#SmallBusinessTips #BajanBusiness #PricingTips

calendar.t: Aftercare tips that bring clients back
calendar.text:
Want clients to come BACK? Give them aftercare 💗

Tell every cluster lash client:
1. Keep them dry for the first 24 hours
2. No oil-based cleansers near the lashes
3. Brush them gently every morning
4. Never pull them off: use remover and let them slide

Clients who look after their lashes love their results, and come back to you 🔁

Save this, lash girls 📌
